extracted.name: Homemade Baking Powder Recipe
extracted.description: This baking powder recipe is a lifesaver when you're in the middle of baking and realize you have none of it on hand — it's so easy to make some yourself!
instruction_lines: Mix cream of tartar and baking soda together in a small bowl. To store, whisk cornstarch into mixture and keep in an airtight container.
